season.evidence: Logged ascents July dominant (35 of ~48), then Aug 9. notes: Probable duplicate filing: Direct East Ridge and Southeast Glaciers (Standard) both read as Luna Col -> east ridge bumps with a 20-25 ft step -> Fury glacier -> summit fin, so every Luna Col recording fits both. One ascent goes to one route, so none assigned and no facts proposed. Useful in-season facts for whichever route the owner keeps (4 Jul 2026, aid 3255987): in early July the talus after the third ridge bump is fully snow-covered, wet mossy slabs lead to a firm snowfield at about 6,800 ft needing crampons, roped travel from the flat shelf near 7,500 ft, and the bergschrund was bypassed far to the west; 5th class step was rappelled coming down. Also 2 Aug 2025: the cliffy waypoints near 6,500 ft are best skirted 100-200 ft higher. North Buttress has no harvested ascent. Direct East Ridge has no Trailhead pin; no add proposed because the recordings start at a camp, not a trailhead.
